title: Sherry Tasting
text: Overall excellent.  We were initially concerned when our driver spoke little English and at times seemed lost. He seemed lost in both Seville and Jerez and did not use GPS. He kept driving around in circles but he did finally reach our destination . He did attempt to point some things out to us but since he didn't speak English we did not know what he was saying . Once we finally arrived to the bodega things were much better.The Byass bodega was stunningly beautiful and our private tour very informative.
